# S2 v2: labelled fallback ablation at threshold 0.5 (generated by scripts/fsn_v2_summaries.py)

Test split, 3 single-item images per class, seed 0: n = 229 images, 92 of 123 classes; leak-free (no train near-duplicate, S3) n = 175. Fresh YOLO + Qwen run on the fixed code; knowledge-layer resolution uses the current shared.food_lookup (partial tier off, empty rows = miss). MS2 errors: 0.

Reproducibility vs the v1 cache (229 common images): identical YOLO top-1 229, identical YOLO conf 229, identical unhinted VLM name 229, identical hinted VLM name 229.
